description: A <<- closing marker preceded by a no-break space ends the heredoc
notes: The spec lets spaces precede the closing marker of a <<- heredoc without saying which characters count as spaces: Comments and Whitespace treats tabs as whitespace as well as U+0020, and Template Literals interprets space characters by Unicode's definition for strip markers, which includes U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE. hashicorp/hcl compares each candidate line with its leading and trailing Unicode whitespace removed by bytes.TrimSpace, for both heredoc forms (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), and bytes.TrimSpace also removes U+00A0. If only U+0020 and tabs counted, this heredoc would be unterminated.
